CLAUDE.md — gtfs2emis

Source: CLAUDE.md

gtfs2emis is an R package that estimates public transport emissions from GTFS data with a bottom-up model. transport_model() turns a GTFS feed into stop-to-stop road segments with speeds and distances (via {gtfs2gps}). The ef_*() functions return emission factors from four sources: Europe EMEP/EEA, Brazil CETESB, USA MOVES and USA EMFAC, plus scaled-Euro local factors. emission_model() combines segments, fleet data and emission factors. The emis_*() helpers summarise the result by time, vehicle and pollutant, or on a spatial grid. It is built on data.table, sf, units, checkmate, terra and future/furrr. Published on CRAN; developed by Ipea (ipeaGIT). Maintainer (cre): Joao Bazzo; authors include Rafael H. M. Pereira and Pedro R. Andrade. License MIT. Docs: https://ipea.github.io/gtfs2emis/ (DESCRIPTION still points to the dead ipeagit host; audit item #30). Method paper: Vieira, Pereira & Andrade (2022), doi:10.31219/osf.io/8m2cy. Default branch: master.

Core principles

  • Correct emissions first. Emission factors must match their source (EMEP/EEA, CETESB, MOVES, EMFAC), within each source’s speed validity range. Units (km/h, km, g/km, g) are part of the API. An unknown pollutant/vehicle/Euro/model-year combination is an error, never a silent NA.
  • Never surprise the caller. Functions don’t modify the user’s GTFS, tp_model, fleet data or emi_list (data.table::copy()).
  • Parallel = sequential. transport_model() and emission_model() must give the same result with parallel = TRUE and parallel = FALSE.
  • CRAN-ready at all times. R CMD check --as-cran: 0 errors, 0 warnings. Examples and vignettes use ≤ 2 cores and write only to tempdir().
  • Plan first. Enter plan mode before non-trivial tasks. Every plan is reviewed by two adversarial agents that improve it and make it simpler, with as little code change as possible. Present the plan only when both agents agree (max 3 rounds, then escalate the disagreement). Plans live in quality_reports/plans/.
  • Verify after. Every task ends with the gates below, not with “should work”.
  • Learn from corrections. Log [LEARN:category] wrong → right in MEMORY.md.
  • Code style. Use package::function() in new code (the data.table operators already imported are the exception). Otherwise match the style of the file you are editing.

Conventions are in .claude/rules/r-package-conventions.md; gates are in .claude/rules/quality-gates.md.

Repository map

gtfs2emis/
├── DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE        # NAMESPACE is roxygen-generated; never hand-edit
├── R/
│   ├── transport_model.R         # GTFS → sf segments (gtfs2gps), parallel/output_path
│   ├── emission_model.R          # tp_model + fleet + EF → emi_list, parallel
│   ├── ef_europe_emep.R, ef_brazil_cetesb.R, ef_usa_moves.R, ef_usa_emfac.R, ef_scaled_euro.R
│   ├── emi_europe_emep_wear.R    # non-exhaust (tyre, brake, road wear)
│   ├── slope_class_europe_emep.R # road slope from a DEM (terra)
│   ├── emis_summary.R, emis_to_dt.R, emis_grid.R   # post-processing
│   ├── multiply_ef.R, fuel_correction.R            # internal helpers
│   ├── data.R                    # docs for the EF databases
│   ├── utils.R                   # @importFrom, globalVariables
│   └── _pkgdown.yml              # stray copy; the root _pkgdown.yml is authoritative
├── data/*.rda                    # EF databases (ef_*_db), built by data-raw/*.R
├── data-raw/                     # scripts that build data/; Rbuildignored
├── tests/testthat/               # test_<function>.R; setup.R builds shared fixtures (needs gtfstools)
├── inst/extdata/                 # irl_dub_*, bra_cur_* (+ srtm.tif), usa_det_* GTFS + fleet fixtures
├── vignettes/                    # intro, emission factors, fleet data, non-exhaust
├── README.md                     # hand-written (no README.Rmd)
├── NEWS.md, cran-comments.md, _pkgdown.yml
└── .github/workflows/            # R-CMD-check (+ CRAN variant), test-coverage, pkgdown

Exports: transport_model · emission_model · ef_europe_emep, ef_brazil_cetesb, ef_usa_moves, ef_usa_emfac, ef_scaled_euro · emi_europe_emep_wear · slope_class_europe_emep · emis_summary, emis_to_dt, emis_grid.

Local-only workflow files (gitignored and Rbuildignored): MEMORY.md, quality_reports/, templates/, and everything in .claude/ except rules/.

Commands

devtools::load_all()
devtools::document()                          # regenerate man/, NAMESPACE
devtools::test()                              # full suite (setup.R needs gtfstools)
devtools::test(filter = "ef_europe_emep")     # matches tests/testthat/test_ef_europe_emep.R
devtools::check(document = FALSE, args = "--as-cran")   # run in background
pkgdown::build_site()
covr::package_coverage()
  • .Rbuildignore excludes tests/, so tests do not run on CRAN. They run locally and on GitHub Actions.
  • core.autocrlf=true: regenerated files can show line-ending-only diffs. Check drift with git diff, not git status.
  • Parallel workers load the installed gtfs2emis, not load_all() code. Install before testing a changed worker path.

Quality gates (summary)

Checkpoint Must hold
Commit document() produces no content drift; tests for touched functions pass; known-value check for EF/emission math changes; parallel/sequential parity if worker code changed; NEWS.md entry for user-facing changes
PR Full test() passes; check(--as-cran) gives 0 errors / 0 warnings, NOTEs triaged; review loop converged; r-package-reviewer 0 CRITICAL/MAJOR
Release /g2e-package-check; win-builder + R-hub; compatibility with current {gtfs2gps}; cran-comments.md updated

Never use --no-verify. Details: .claude/rules/quality-gates.md.

Skills and agents

These are local to the maintainer’s Claude setup and are not in git. In a fresh clone, follow the rules in .claude/rules/ directly.

Project skills carry a g2e- prefix so user-level skills with the same base name can’t shadow them. In this repo, always use the g2e- version: use /g2e-commit, never a generic /commit that merges to master. Where user-level rules conflict with .claude/rules/, the project rules win.

  • /g2e-package-check: document, test, check --as-cran, triage, reviewer report.
  • /g2e-commit: Gate 1, then branch and commit. Push and PR only when asked, after Gate 2. Merging to master only on explicit request.
  • /g2e-diagnose: root-cause a failing test or wrong emission result.
  • /g2e-checkpoint, /g2e-compress-session, /context-status: session state.
  • /g2e-learn: turn a session discovery into a reusable skill.
  • Agent r-package-reviewer: read-only CRAN and convention review of package source.

Working mode

  1. Plan: for non-trivial tasks, enter plan mode, explore, ask only about real decisions, pass the adversarial plan review, and get approval.
  2. Execute (contractor mode): after approval, work autonomously through implement → verify → parallel review → fix, looping until reviews come back dry (see .claude/rules/orchestrator-protocol.md). Come back only for ambiguity or a decision that belongs to the user.
  3. Report: summarise what changed, gate results, open questions; log the session.

No commits, pushes, PRs, merges, version bumps or .github/workflows/ changes without an explicit request. Never hand-edit generated files (NAMESPACE, man/*.Rd) or data/*.rda (rebuild via data-raw/).
